BASE = "BASE"
Read BASE/codebook-parties.md and the papers in BASE/data/batches/r2-parties-policy-01.json (each has id, title, abstract). Open no other file. Code every paper by hand from its title and abstract, reading each abstract to its end. Write BASE/data/coded/r2-parties-policy-01.jsonl with exactly one JSON object per line per paper, in the output format the codebook specifies, ids copied exactly. Return only: the number of papers coded and the count per PARTIES category.
